title: rosa alpina var. lagenaria
intro: Rosa alpina var. lagenaria, commonly known as Alpine Rose, is a fragrant, white-flowering plant native to the European Alps. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. Alpine Rose is known for its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits, including soothing digestive issues and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents of Rosa alpina var. lagenaria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
